body:
This change makes safe cleanup protect active tools and user data across host and container environments, prunes excluded and foreign filesystems before reading them, and counts only attributable writable bytes. It addresses all nine issues collected by #27 in this PR.

## Requirements and changes

| Issue | Result |
| --- | --- |
| #17 | Protect executable/script/cwd/open paths and dss's own installation; retain per-entry npx cleanup, add bunx/pnpm/Yarn dlx entries, and finish partial audits on controlled aborts. |
| #18 | Add Telegram, Chromium/Safari/WebKit and marker-validated Electron cache coverage plus inactive agent scratch; make eligible inactive lockfile-backed node_modules and old browser revisions safe; protect artifact-local Git content, databases and explicit MCP profiles. Telegram downloaded media remains moderate with a secret-chat warning. |
| #19 | Preserve already-resolved PR #15 container/opam fixes and PR #20's Deno metadata fix; accept unique container-name prefixes, report unmatched/ambiguous filters, retain publish stderr and fail fast with actionable npm trusted-publisher diagnostics. |
| #21 | Share one measurement snapshot and stat cache per container/run, reuse discovered inspect data, forget deleted paths, prefer authoritative upperdir blocks, serialize all diff callers, and trace measurement progress. Fresh Git discovery before stopped-container removal protects newly copied work. |
| #22 | Make fixture proc/process data hermetic, guard real Docker calls, respect no-docker during accounting and saved-report cleanup, enforce memory/candidate/output budgets, clean fixture roots, and cap/isolate DinD fixtures. |
| #23 | Prune runtime roots, nested overlay/read-only mounts and unselected filesystem boundaries. Explicit ordinary roots/subroots remain usable. Recheck boundaries before removal. |
| #24 | Match full-path globs and every ancestor, restrict basename matching to separator-free patterns, and prune every scanner's single/batched discovery and usage paths before reads. Reject recursive removal containing excluded descendants, including newly discovered ones. |
| #25 | Preserve partial per-PID evidence, scope uncertainty by UID/command/data roots, attempt noninteractive privileged read-only inspection, and give one environment-level hint. Unrelated caches remain usable. |
| #26 | Detect an overlay root without contacting Docker; unknown attribution contributes zero reclaimable bytes. Propagate writable/image/unknown fields through all items, including Rust leaves, reports, totals and cleanup. Image-only caches remain blocked with container/image-removal advice. |

The [complete requirement inventory and alternatives](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/blob/issue-27-811cbcce0473/docs/case-studies/issue-27/plan.md) covers every child request. The [case-study index](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/blob/issue-27-811cbcce0473/docs/case-studies/issue-27/README.md) links all nine reports, primary-source component research, archived issue/comments, complete compressed release logs, line-numbered errors, registry data, related PR patches and regression evidence. Existing inherited case studies are preserved.

## Reproduction and validation

Minimal regression tests failed before each fix; their logs are archived. Run `node --test --test-timeout=30000 tests/issue-27-*.test.js` for the aggregate cases. They exercise all four requested exclusion patterns, mount/exclusion pruning before listing or shell measurement (including zero-depth globstars), no-Docker paths, unrelated unreadable PIDs, own-installation/script protection, every new rule family with actual cleanup, MCP/user-data preservation, writable snapshots/upperdirs and partial audits.

- Node: **799 passing tests**.
- Bun: **799 passing tests**.
- Deno with `--allow-read`: **696 passing tests and 8 steps**.
- Focused aggregate/publish-classifier suite: **59 passing tests**.
- Lint, strict lint of changed source/tests, formatting, duplication, syntax, file limits and required documentation checks passed locally.
- Fresh CI on `e7d6210`: [checks and release run 37978017997](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/actions/runs/37978017997) passed the full runtime matrix, capped DinD integration and repository gates. Security, link and example-app workflows also passed; failure logs and the correction are archived.
- Final documentation head `5e0075a`: [checks run 37978790939](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/actions/runs/37978790939), security, links and example-app workflows all passed. The product code matches the full-matrix passing head above.
- Local bounded `npm run test:dind` could not start: this host rejects the capped container's cgroup configuration before dss runs. The archived log records the exact error. The capped integration passed in [PR CI run 37975901140](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/actions/runs/37975901140).

No UI change is included. New cleanup rules preserve Telegram databases, browser profiles, Electron local storage and Playwright MCP data. Whole agent scratch remains moderate with inactivity/Git safeguards; unidentified temporary files are preserved. A minor changeset prepares the automatic release.

## Upstream and release findings

Filed [moby/moby#53906](https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/53906) with the incident/source evidence, a finite memory-capped diagnostic, workarounds and suggested cancellation/upperdir changes. The original Docker 29.6.1 containerd OOM was **not reproduced** on this checkout's fuse-overlayfs daemon. Client budgets reduce risk but cannot hard-bound a remote daemon's full changes walk; unavailable/unsafe measurement remains unknown.

The old Deno release gate is **already resolved by PR #20**. Fresh main release run [37948829224](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/actions/runs/37948829224) instead failed npm PUT with E404. npm latest remains 0.13.1 in the archived snapshot. This PR implements the requested **loud-failure alternative**, recovering diagnostics and explaining publisher owner/repository/workflow/direct-publish permissions after transfer. It does not claim successful publication or access to npm package settings.

Fixes #27
Fixes #17
Fixes #18
Fixes #19
Fixes #21

Fixes #24
Fixes #25

title: Make safe cleanup protect active tools, prune foreign paths and count writable bytes
